l1: yl2ZDV1MzN4HbQJbMihG|1.06|AI news never stops. The same story shows up everywhere, under new headlines.
l2: xctasy8XvGp2cVO9HL9k|1.06|AI DR is a machine that reads it for you.
l3: yl2ZDV1MzN4HbQJbMihG|1.06|Every thirty minutes, it pulls from Hacker News, Hugging Face, GitHub releases, Lobsters, and RSS feeds.
l4: xctasy8XvGp2cVO9HL9k|1.06|It merges duplicates into one story. Then it scores each one.
l5: yl2ZDV1MzN4HbQJbMihG|1.06|No editor picks the order. The ranking is plain code, and the rules are public.
l6: xctasy8XvGp2cVO9HL9k|1.06|The top stories of the last twenty-four hours become one edition. Up to sixteen bullets, in English, and in Vietnamese.
l7: yl2ZDV1MzN4HbQJbMihG|1.06|Read it on the site. By email from seven a.m., your time. On Telegram, on Facebook, and as a daily video.
l8: xctasy8XvGp2cVO9HL9k|1.06|Every story links to the original. AI DR. What's happening in AI today?
